STAFF PARKING PERMITS

Permits expire on December 31. Renew online by December 15 to receive the new permit before the holiday closure. Employees who have changed vehicles must update the registration number before paying. A renewed permit does not reserve a particular space.

passages.title: Local supplier directory · Document 1
passages.text:
THE DIRECTORY THAT STAYS CURRENT

When business owner Leo Grant created an online directory of local suppliers, he expected to spend most of his time adding new listings. Instead, he found that keeping opening hours and contact details current was the harder task. The directory now sends each listed business a monthly confirmation request. Listings that receive no response for three months are marked unverified rather than removed.

Grant says the label is intended to warn readers, not to suggest that the business has closed. Basic listings remain free. Suppliers may pay for additional photographs, but paid status does not affect search order or verification labels. A volunteer team checks reported errors against businesses' own published information before making changes.

COLLECTING FROM A PARCEL LOCKER

Use the six-digit code in your collection message to open the assigned compartment. Codes become active only after the courier confirms the parcel has been placed inside. A message saying an item is on its way is not a collection notice.

You have three days from the collection notice to pick up your parcel. After that, it returns to the depot. Oversized parcels cannot be stored in lockers; the message will provide another collection location. If a door opens but the compartment is empty, close it and contact support before using any other code. Do not leave packaging beside the lockers. Separate recycling bins are located in the supermarket entrance.

passages.title: Music school lesson cancellation · Document 1
passages.text:
Dear adult learners,

We are changing our cancellation policy from February 1. Individual lessons canceled at least twenty-four hours in advance can be moved to another time within the same term, subject to the teacher's availability. Later cancellations cannot normally be made up. If the teacher cancels, however, you may choose a replacement lesson or a credit, regardless of notice.

Group classes follow a different policy: recordings and notes are provided for absences, but individual makeup sessions are not included. Please contact the office rather than your teacher to request a schedule change so our attendance records remain accurate. Existing January bookings are governed by the previous policy.

School Office

passages.title: Tool library membership · Document 1
passages.text:
BORROW MORE, BUY LESS

A yearly membership at the Eastside Tool Library costs $30 and lets you borrow up to three tools at once. Most loans last seven days. High-demand items, marked with a star in the catalog, are limited to three days and cannot be renewed. Other loans can be renewed once if no one is waiting.

Members receive a safety demonstration before borrowing powered tools for the first time. This does not qualify them to carry out regulated electrical or building work. Tools must be returned clean and complete. Report damage immediately; ordinary wear is covered by membership, while misuse may result in a repair charge. Reservations may be collected from noon on the first booked day.

passages.title: Hotel breakfast feedback · Document 1
passages.text:
Dear Ms. Reed,

Thank you for telling us about the long breakfast queue during your stay. We have reviewed the times recorded by our staff and found that two tour groups arrived together, leaving too few tables for other guests. We are now asking group organizers to reserve staggered breakfast times.

We have also added a takeaway option for guests with early departures. This includes fruit, a sandwich and a cold drink; it is not a full hot breakfast. As your room rate already included breakfast, there is no additional charge for choosing this option. Please request it by 20:00 the evening before departure. Your comments helped us identify the problem, and we appreciate the opportunity to improve.

Guest Services

passages.title: Technical report summary · Document 1
passages.text:
PILOT OF MOTION-SENSOR LIGHTING

During a six-week pilot on the third floor, electricity used for lighting fell by 18 percent compared with the same six weeks last year. Occupancy was also lower by about 10 percent, so the savings cannot be attributed entirely to the new sensors. Staff reported that lights sometimes switched off while people were sitting still.

The facilities team has lengthened the delay before switch-off and will repeat measurements at normal occupancy. No building-wide purchase has been approved. The next report will separate lighting use from total floor electricity, since computers and heating are outside the pilot's scope. Staff should continue reporting dark areas through the maintenance portal rather than covering the sensors.

passages.title: School tablet loan · Document 1
passages.text:
LEARNING CENTRE TABLET LOANS

Members may borrow a tablet for up to fourteen days. A refundable $50 deposit is required. Devices must be returned with their charging cable and case; missing accessories are charged at replacement cost. Loans cannot be renewed, but a new loan may be requested after a seven-day gap. Before return, sign out of personal accounts. Staff will reset the device after checking the contents. Do not attempt a factory reset yourself because it removes the library's management settings.

passages.title: School tablet loan · Document 2
passages.text:

To: Learning Centre

My colleague could bring the tablet back on March 17 if someone else is allowed to return it. Please confirm what I should arrange.

passages.title: School tablet loan · Document 3
passages.text:
To: Owen Pike

We cannot extend this loan. Your colleague may return T18 on March 17, provided the cable and case are included. You should sign out of your accounts before handing it over. We will return the deposit after inspecting the complete set. If the cable is missing, its $12 replacement cost will be deducted. Please do not reset the device; our staff will do that after inspection.

passages.title: Roof garden workshop registration · Document 1
passages.text:
ROOF GARDEN WORKSHOP — APRIL 27

Choose either a 09:00 introductory session or a 13:00 advanced session. Each lasts two hours and costs $25, including basic materials. The advanced session assumes experience growing plants in containers. A combined booking for both costs $40. Bring gloves; tools are supplied. The roof is reached by a lift, but the final doorway is narrow. Please contact us about access needs before booking. In heavy rain, sessions move to the indoor greenhouse, with the same start times.

My sister and I are both beginners and want to attend together. We can arrive only after noon. Would the advanced session be suitable? We would also like to know whether we can borrow gloves. Neither of us has garden equipment, and we would rather not purchase anything just for one afternoon.

passages.title: Roof garden workshop registration · Document 3
passages.text:
To: Leila North

We do not recommend the advanced session for beginners. Instead, we can offer two places in an extra introductory session at 15:30, added because the morning one is full. The same fee and material arrangements apply. Gloves cannot be borrowed for hygiene reasons, but ordinary household work gloves are suitable. Please reply by Thursday so we can hold the two places; payment is due on confirmation.
